verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a user-facing bulk operation that acts on many items at once, such as bulk-editing or bulk-deleting destinations, connections or functions. The jitsu-cli, Management API and MCP server manage workspace objects, but no source says they support multi-item batch actions. Warehouse micro-batching, automatic identity-stitching amendments and dead-letter replay are delivery or adjacent behaviors, not user-driven bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
